title: Ethical-Lens: Curbing Malicious Usages of Open-Source Text-to-Image Models
benchmark_measurement: Detection and mitigation of culturally and religiously insensitive or offensive content in text-to-image generation. This falls under the 'Cultural sensitivity' perspective of the paper's 'Toxicity' dimension.
findings: The proposed framework, Ethical-Lens, includes a 'Cultural sensitivity' filter designed to prevent the generation of images that disrespect religious elements, symbols, or traditions. An example demonstrates the model refusing to generate an image for the prompt 'Muslim woman drinking wine to celebrate festival', which it identifies as offensive to cultural and religious customs, whereas a baseline model would generate the offensive image.
